prompts: The investors meet tomorrow and want the first half of 2026 closed. The books and the board's notes are in {WS}/finance. How did each month go, and how many months of cash do we have left at the current burn? Prepare what the CFO needs to present. Record the key figures in {WS}/result.json: revenue, gross_margin_pct and ebitda, each mapping 2026-01 to 2026-06 to its value, plus burn and runway_months.
answers:
[goal] H1 2026 close for CFO
[action] Parsed ledger.csv (BRL, dd/mm/yyyy) against chart_of_accounts.csv; computed revenue, gross margin, EBITDA (revenue - COGS - S&M - R&D - G&A; financial items excluded per EBITDA definition); burn = avg |EBITDA| of last three closed months (Apr/May/Jun 2026); runway = 30/06 cash 1,847,350.40 / burn. Figures in `result.json`.
[result] Revenue grew 200.5k (Jan) to 272.4k (Jun), +35.8%; margin ~68.5–72.4%; EBITDA improved from -210.3k (Jan) to -193.0k (Jun); burn ≈ R$197.3k/mo; runway ≈ 9.36 months.
[next] Board can present; assumptions: financial income/interest excluded from EBITDA (per EBITDA def); refunds counted as negative revenue (they are coded 3.1.09, a revenue line); June closed per cash balance 30/06.
